title: HarnessSecurity-Bench: Do Security Mechanisms Really Protect Coding Agent Harnesses?
title_zh: HarnessSecurity-Bench：安全机制是否真能保护编码智能体框架？

paragraphs.en: Coding agent harnesses mediate tool use and authorize actions, yet their security mechanisms and runtime effects remain incompletely characterized. We present HarnessSecurity , the first systematic empirical study and benchmark of open- and closed-source coding agent harnesses. First, we derive a ten-mechanism taxonomy and then assess 400 harness–mechanism cells using independent ratings by researchers and large language model (LLM) judges. We find that about half of confirmed mechanism implementations are opt-in, while closed-source harnesses exhibit substantial evidence gaps. Second, we introduce HarnessSecurity-Bench , a benchmark of 23 tasks across five attack surfaces without sacrificing legitimate task requirements. Using separate deterministic oracles to measure task utility and attack effects with security setting comparisons, we evaluate nine mechanisms across six leading harnesses: Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, gptme, Qwen Code, and GitHub Copilot. Under a controlled LLM baseline GLM-5.2 , we conduct 2,500 trials, recording 81,155 tool calls and over 2.2 billion tokens. Enabling auto-approve increases utility and raises attack success from 29.2% to 95.6%. Network isolation and read-only mode reduce attack effects with substantial utility losses, while command allowlisting and command denylisting reduce attack effects with a small utility loss and a utility gain, respectively. Task-level cases show that restrictions on a shared capability can obstruct both legitimate and malicious operations, and that allowed tools or commands can leave unauthorized operations reachable through alternative execution paths. Harness providers should make security settings verifiable, test alternative execution paths to protected operations, and assess attack effects alongside task utility and execution costs.
paragraphs.zh: 编码智能体利用中介工具并授权操作，但其安全机制和运行时影响尚未得到完整描述。 我们提出了 HarnessSecurity，这是首个对开源和闭源编码智能体中介进行系统性实证研究和基准测试的框架。 首先，我们构建了一个包含十种机制的分类体系，随后通过研究人员和大型语言模型（LLM）评审员的独立评分，评估了 400 个中介-机制组合单元。 我们发现，约一半已确认的机制实现为可选启用模式，而闭源中介则存在显著的证据空白。 其次，我们引入了 HarnessSecurity-Bench，这是一个包含 23 项任务的基准测试，覆盖五种攻击面，同时不牺牲合法任务需求。 通过独立的确定性预言子分别测量任务效用和攻击影响，并对比不同安全设置，我们对 Claude Code、Codex CLI、Gemini CLI、gptme、Qwen Code 和 GitHub Copilot 这六款主流中介中的九种机制进行了评估。 在受控的 LLM 基线模型 GLM-5.2 下，我们进行了 2,500 次试验，记录了 81,155 次工具调用和超过 22 亿个词元。 启用自动批准功能可提升任务效用，并将攻击成功率从 29.2% 提高到 95.6%。 网络隔离和只读模式虽能减少攻击影响，但也会造成显著的效用损失；而命令白名单和命令黑名单则分别以较小的效用损失和一定的效用增益来降低攻击影响。 任务层面的案例表明，对共享能力的限制可能同时阻碍合法与恶意操作，而允许使用的工具或命令也可能通过替代执行路径使未经授权的操作成为可能。 中介提供商应确保安全设置可验证，测试替代执行路径对受保护操作的影响，并评估攻击影响与任务效用及执行成本之间的关系。

paragraphs.en: Coding agents based on large language models (LLMs) have moved from demonstrations to production, with products such as Claude Code [ 5 ] and Codex CLI [ 38 ] supporting autonomous repository-level software development. Each agent couples an LLM with a coding agent harness that assembles context, mediates tool use, and authorizes actions [ 34 , 15 ] . Harness design affects task success and resource costs even when the underlying model is held fixed [ 19 , 53 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 基于大型语言模型（LLM）的编码智能体已从演示阶段进入实际部署，例如 Claude Code [ 5 ] 和 Codex CLI [ 38 ] 等产品已支持在仓库级别进行自主软件开发。 每个智能体都将一个 LLM 与编码智能体框架相结合，该框架负责整合上下文、协调工具使用并授权执行操作 [ 34 , 15 ] 。 即使底层模型保持不变，框架的设计也会影响任务成功率和资源消耗 [ 19 , 53 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Expanding coding agents’ capabilities also introduces risks in how their harnesses handle untrusted inputs, authorize tool execution, and process repository data. Recent disclosures illustrate how these risks arise in practice. In particular, prompt injection through issue titles induced shell command execution in a mirror of Cline’s triage workflow [ 25 ] , demonstrating how untrusted content can redirect agent actions. Moreover, OpenAI and Anthropic reported network isolation failures during cybersecurity evaluations [ 39 , 9 ] , while IDEsaster showed how agent file edits triggered unsafe behaviors in the surrounding IDE [ 33 ] . An investigation also reported that ZCode uploaded workspace snapshots containing Git history [ 20 ] , raising confidentiality concerns about the scope of repository data transmitted by agent tools.
paragraphs.zh: 扩展编码智能体的能力也会带来风险，体现在其控制机制处理不可信输入、授权工具执行以及处理仓库数据的方式上。 近期的披露案例说明了这些风险在实践中是如何产生的。 特别是，通过问题标题进行的提示注入诱发了 Shell 命令的执行，重现了 Cline 的初步分类工作流程 [ 25 ]，这表明不可信内容如何引导智能体的行为偏离原方向。 此外，OpenAI 和 Anthropic 在网络安全评估中报告了网络隔离失败的问题 [ 39 , 9 ]，而 IDEsaster 则展示了智能体对文件的修改如何在周围的 IDE 中触发不安全行为 [ 33 ]。 一项调查还报告称，ZCode 上传了包含 Git 历史记录的工作区快照 [ 20 ]，引发了关于智能体工具所传输的仓库数据范围是否涉及机密信息的担忧。

paragraphs.en: Prior work has studied agent security from several perspectives. First, surveys and empirical studies classify agent defenses, harness architectures, and execution controls, with an inspection of harness source code and public product materials [ 26 , 28 , 45 , 12 , 3 , 17 ] . Second, agent security studies audit permissions and violations of information flows, evaluate attacks, defenses, and authorization policies in agent workflows [ 30 , 18 , 58 , 11 , 13 ] . Third, coding agent benchmarks also examine how adversarial instructions, tool descriptions, issues, and skills redirect development actions [ 32 , 55 , 49 , 48 , 37 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 先前的研究从多个角度探讨了智能体安全性。 首先，综述和实证研究对智能体防御机制、运行架构和执行控制进行了分类，并检查了运行环境的源代码及公开的产品材料 [ 26 , 28 , 45 , 12 , 3 , 17 ] 。 其次，智能体安全性研究审计了权限和信息流的违规情况，并评估了智能体工作流程中的攻击、防御和授权策略 [ 30 , 18 , 58 , 11 , 13 ] 。 第三，智能体编码基准测试还研究了对抗性指令、工具描述、问题及技能如何引导开发行为的转向 [ 32 , 55 , 49 , 48 , 37 ] 。

paragraphs.en: However, existing studies remain limited in their empirical assessment of native security mechanisms across coding agent harnesses. Architectural mapping and literature reviews do not systematically assess mechanism implementation and default settings across coding products [ 28 , 45 ] . Empirical comparisons cover only three coding agents [ 26 ] or eleven source-accessible harnesses [ 12 ] , leaving closed-source products underrepresented. Practitioner comparisons describe native settings but do not report independent implementation status [ 3 , 17 ] . These limitations leave a gap in the systematic empirical study of mechanism implementation and default settings across open- and closed-source coding agent harnesses. Existing benchmarks also remain limited in their comparative evaluation of security mechanisms. IssueTrojanBench covers three coding agents on two Python repositories, while CapScope compares authorization policies within one Pi-based harness on five Python repair tasks [ 49 , 13 ] . Other evaluations focus on attacks through particular resources, including instruction files, tool descriptions, and skills [ 32 , 55 , 48 , 37 ] . Although some measure both task utility and attack outcomes [ 48 , 37 ] , they do not systematically isolate the effects of mechanism settings across harnesses and attack surfaces. These limitations leave a gap in the comparative assessment of security mechanisms across coding harnesses and attack surfaces . sents.en: To bridge this research gap, we raise the following research questions (RQs):
sents.zh: 为了填补这一研究空白，我们提出以下研究问题（RQs）：

paragraphs.en: What distinct security mechanisms can be identified in real coding agent harnesses?
paragraphs.zh: 在实际的编码智能体框架中，可以识别出哪些独特的安全机制？

paragraphs.en: To what degree are these mechanisms implemented?
paragraphs.zh: 这些机制在多大程度上得到了实施？

paragraphs.en: How do security mechanisms in coding agent harnesses affect security and utility during adversarially augmented task execution?
paragraphs.zh: 编码智能体框架中的安全机制在对抗性增强任务执行期间如何影响安全性与效用？

paragraphs.en: To address these research questions, we present HarnessSecurity , an empirical study of 40 coding agent harnesses: 27 open-source and 13 closed-source products. For RQ1, we derive a taxonomy of ten security mechanisms for assessment across coding agent harnesses. For RQ2, we assess all 400 harness–mechanism cells, recording evidence on implementation status, default settings, and supported configurations. These analyses in RQ1 and RQ2 establish the mechanism definitions and configurations used in the runtime evaluation. For RQ3, we introduce HarnessSecurity-Bench (HSB), a benchmark comprising 23 coding tasks spanning diverse programming languages, including Python, JavaScript, C#, C++, Go, and Ruby. HSB covers nine of the ten mechanisms across six harnesses. We augment task environments with misleading context and malicious resources across five attack surfaces (shown in A–E of Fig. 1 ). This augmentation preserves legitimate user instructions, task requirements, utility oracles, and valid paths to task completion. HSB provides separate deterministic oracles to measure task utility and attack effects, runs trials in isolated Docker containers, and compares enabled and disabled settings of native security mechanisms under the same execution environment. Table 1 compares HSB with prior coding agent evaluations across harness coverage, attack surfaces, comparison of security mechanism settings, and evaluation oracles.
paragraphs.zh: 为了解决这些研究问题，我们提出了 HarnessSecurity，这是一项针对 40 种编码智能体框架的经验性研究：其中包含 27 种开源产品和 13 种闭源产品。 针对研究问题 1（RQ1），我们构建了一个包含十种安全机制的分类体系，用于对各类编码智能体框架进行评估。 针对研究问题 2（RQ2），我们对全部 400 个“框架–机制”组合单元进行了评估，并记录了其实现状态、默认设置及支持配置的相关证据。 RQ1 和 RQ2 中的这些分析确立了在运行时评估中使用的机制定义和配置。 针对研究问题 3（RQ3），我们引入了 HarnessSecurity-Bench（HSB），这是一个基准测试，包含 23 项编码任务，涵盖 Python、JavaScript、C#、C++、Go 和 Ruby 等多种编程语言。 HSB 在六个框架中覆盖了十种机制中的九种。 我们在五个攻击面（如图 1 的 A–E 所示）中，通过添加误导性上下文和恶意资源来增强任务环境。 这种增强保留了合法的用户指令、任务要求、效用预言机以及完成任务的有效路径。 HSB 提供了独立的确定性预言机，用于衡量任务效用和攻击效果；在隔离的 Docker 容器中运行测试，并在相同的执行环境中比较原生安全机制的启用与禁用设置。 表 1 从框架覆盖范围、攻击面、安全机制设置的对比以及评估预言机等角度，将 HSB 与以往的编码智能体评估进行了比较。

paragraphs.en: The RQ1 study established a taxonomy of ten security mechanisms, and the RQ2 assessment confirmed implementation in 205 of 400 harness–mechanism cells and absence in 83, while 112 remain unresolved. The RQ3 evaluation comprised 2,500 trials under GLM-5.2 across six harnesses, recording 81,155 tool calls, over 2.2 billion native tokens, and 589.32 hours of cumulative agent execution time. The security and utility effects differ across mechanisms, harnesses, and tasks. Enabling auto-approve increased both utility and attack success, with attack success rising from 29.2% to 95.6%. Network isolation and read-only mode reduced attack success from 57.1% to 0.8% and from 8.3% to 0.8%, respectively, with utility losses of 24.5 and 34.0 percentage points. Command allowlisting and command denylisting reduced attack effects with a small utility loss and a utility gain, respectively. Task-level cases show that restricting a shared capability can block both legitimate and malicious operations, while alternative execution paths can leave unauthorized operations reachable. Harness development should test alternative execution paths to protected operations and evaluate security restrictions in terms of attack effects, legitimate task utility, and execution costs. We summarize our contributions as follows:
paragraphs.zh: RQ1 研究建立了一个包含十种安全机制的分类体系，而 RQ2 评估确认在 400 个“约束-机制”单元格中有 205 个实现了这些机制，83 个未实现，另有 112 个尚未解决。 RQ3 评估在 GLM-5.2 环境下对六种约束进行了 2,500 次试验，记录了 81,155 次工具调用、超过 22 亿个原生词元以及累计 589.32 小时的智能体执行时间。 不同机制、约束和任务中，安全性和实用性的效果存在差异。 启用自动批准功能同时提升了实用性和攻击成功率，其中攻击成功率从 29.2% 上升至 95.6%。 网络隔离和只读模式分别将攻击成功率从 57.1% 降至 0.8%，以及从 8.3% 降至 0.8%，但实用性的损失分别为 24.5 和 34.0 个百分点。 命令白名单和命令黑名单分别通过较小的实用性损失和实用性增益降低了攻击效果。 任务层面的案例表明，限制共享能力可能会同时阻止合法和恶意操作，而替代执行路径则可能使未经授权的操作仍然可被触发。 在开发约束时，应测试受保护操作的替代执行路径，并从攻击效果、合法任务的实用性以及执行成本等方面评估安全限制。 我们将我们的贡献总结如下：

paragraphs.en: Fig. 1 places six attack surfaces around the five-stage coding agent harness loop. The harness first assembles instructions, repository context, interaction history, and tool definitions for the agent to read. The model plans an action, such as reading a file, editing code, or running a command. The harness then authorizes and executes or routes the request. The resulting interaction updates the context available in later turns [ 34 , 15 , 19 ] . Some harnesses also load reusable skills, delegate subtasks to subagents, and connect to external services through the Model Context Protocol (MCP), an open protocol for connecting LLM applications to external tools and data sources [ 7 , 6 , 8 , 36 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 图 1 在五级编码智能体框架循环周围布置了六个攻击面。 该框架首先组装指令、仓库上下文、交互历史和工具定义，供智能体读取。 模型会规划一项操作，例如读取文件、编辑代码或运行命令。 然后，框架会授权并执行该请求，或将请求路由至其他服务。 由此产生的交互会更新后续回合中可用的上下文 [ 34 , 15 , 19 ] 。 一些框架还会加载可重用的技能、将子任务委托给子智能体，并通过模型上下文协议（MCP）连接到外部服务；MCP 是一种用于将大型语言模型应用连接到外部工具和数据源的开放协议 [ 7 , 6 , 8 , 36 ] 。

paragraphs.en: At different stages of this loop, adversarial resources can influence agent decisions or harness execution. We use the attack surface to refer to a resource, interface, or state that an adversary can manipulate to produce such effects. Building on prior agent security research and frameworks [ 26 , 21 , 58 , 40 ] , we organize coding agent attack surfaces by the resource under adversarial control: repository and workflow artifacts , agent instructions and skills , tool interfaces , knowledge and memory , external services and execution dependencies , and direct user input , as shown in Fig. 1 . Each surrounding panel shows how adversary resources or input can affect the loop. Its numbered markers identify the stages involved.
paragraphs.zh: 在此循环的不同阶段，对抗性资源可能会影响智能体的决策或控制执行过程。 我们将“攻击面”定义为某种资源、接口或状态，对抗方可以通过操控这些元素来产生上述效果。 基于此前关于智能体安全的研究与框架 [ 26 , 21 , 58 , 40 ]，我们按照对抗方可控制的资源类型，对智能体的编码攻击面进行了分类：仓库与工作流程产物、智能体指令与技能、工具接口、知识与记忆、外部服务与执行依赖，以及直接用户输入，如 Fig. 1 所示。 每个周围的图框展示了对抗性资源或输入如何影响该循环。 其中的编号标记指出了所涉及的各个阶段。

paragraphs.en: To construct the coding agent harness dataset for RQ1, we collected candidate harnesses from three channels: (i) GitHub repositories and lists of open-source coding agents; (ii) commercial products identified through vendor material; and (iii) coding agents that appeared in security disclosures and CVEs. The inventory contains 75 records (46, 17, and 12 from these three channels, respectively). After merging 19 pairs of records referring to the same product, we retained 56 unique candidates. For example, we merged two records for Amazon Q Developer CLI, one identified through repository mining and the other through a public security issue [ 4 , 41 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 为构建 RQ1 的编码智能体工具包数据集，我们从三个渠道收集了候选工具包：(i) GitHub 仓库和开源编码智能体的列表；(ii) 通过供应商材料识别出的商业产品；以及 (iii) 出现在安全披露和 CVE 中的编码智能体。 该清单包含 75 条记录（分别来自这三个渠道的 46、17 和 12 条）。 在合并 19 对指向同一产品的记录后，我们保留了 56 个独特的候选项。 例如，我们合并了关于 Amazon Q Developer CLI 的两条记录，一条通过仓库挖掘识别，另一条则通过公开的安全问题识别 [ 4 , 41 ]。

paragraphs.en: To focus on widely adopted, actively maintained coding agent harnesses, we further screened these candidates. For open-source candidates, we applied four screening criteria: (1) the candidate had to be publicly released; (2) its GitHub repository had to have at least 1,000 stars; (3) it had to support an agentic coding workflow with code execution; and (4) publicly available materials had to allow us to assess its security mechanisms. We excluded projects with no maintenance for more than 12 months, as well as general agents and completion-only tools. For closed-source candidates, we required official documentation or CLI materials sufficient to assess their security mechanisms. Excluding 16 candidates, we finally retained 40 harnesses: 27 open-source and 13 closed-source (Table 2 ). paragraphs.en: Following the principles of open and axial coding [ 51 ] , we assigned initial security-related labels to eight harnesses, grouped the labels into mechanism categories, and then examined the remaining 32 harnesses to refine those categories and establish the final security mechanisms.
paragraphs.zh: 遵循开放编码和轴向编码的原则 [ 51 ]，我们为八个安全带分配了初步的安全相关标签，将这些标签归入机制类别，然后检查其余的 32 个安全带，以完善这些类别并确定最终的安全机制。

paragraphs.en: We selected eight initial harnesses covering open- and closed-source products and all four harness types: Aider, Claude Code, and Codex CLI (CLI agents), Cline and GitHub Copilot (IDE extensions), OpenHands and Devin (cloud/platform agents), and Cursor (IDE-based agent). Three researchers, each with at least seven years of software development experience, independently examined the official documentation, CLI references, and source code for eight harnesses in our collected dataset to identify security-related behavior and assign initial security-related labels. For each label, they recorded the associated security behavior and supporting evidence, including source-code locations where available, entry points, and configuration options. The same three researchers then examined the remaining 32 harnesses to extend the initial labels across the full dataset. For each observed behavior, they recorded supporting evidence and compared its protected object, enforcement point, and effect on the relevant operation with existing labels. They added labels for absence and consolidated overlapping labels. The three researchers then discussed the full labels with a fourth researcher who had at least ten years of experience in software development and research. The fourth researcher reviewed the evidence for each label and refined the mechanism categories based on what was protected and where checks occurred, and then adjudicated unresolved disagreements and made the final decisions on category boundaries. For example, labels concerning permitted file locations contributed to both path restriction and workspace boundary candidates. We included workspace boundaries under path restriction because workspace roots specify permitted file targets. Approval prompts were assessed through the auto-approve configuration contrast, while sandbox implementations were classified by the path, network, tool-permission, and approval checks they enforced.
paragraphs.zh: 我们选择了八种初始工具，涵盖开源和闭源产品，以及全部四种工具类型：Aider、Claude Code 和 Codex CLI（CLI 智能体）、Cline 和 GitHub Copilot（IDE 扩展）、OpenHands 和 Devin（云/平台智能体），以及 Cursor（基于 IDE 的智能体）。 三名研究人员各自拥有至少七年软件开发经验，他们独立检查了我们收集的数据集中八种工具的官方文档、CLI 参考和源代码，以识别与安全相关的行为并分配初步的安全相关标签。 对于每个标签，他们都记录了相关的安全行为及支持证据，包括可用时的源代码位置、入口点和配置选项。 随后，这三位研究人员检查了其余的 32 种工具，将初始标签扩展至整个数据集。 对于每种观察到的行为，他们都记录了支持证据，并将其受保护对象、执行点以及对相关操作的影响与现有标签进行比较。 他们为不存在的情况添加了标签，并合并了重叠的标签。 接着，这三位研究人员与第四位研究人员讨论了所有标签；这位第四位研究人员在软件开发和研究方面拥有至少十年经验。 第四位研究人员审查了每个标签的证据，并根据受保护的内容和检查发生的位置调整了机制类别，随后裁定了未解决的争议，并做出了关于类别边界的最终决定。 例如，与允许的文件位置相关的标签同时促成了路径限制和工作空间边界的候选分类。 我们将工作空间边界归入路径限制，因为工作空间根目录指定了允许的文件目标。 通过自动批准配置的对比来评估批准提示，而沙盒实现则根据它们强制执行的路径、网络、工具权限和批准检查进行分类。

paragraphs.en: The taxonomy distinguishes mechanisms by the resources or operations they govern and their enforcement points in the harness loop (as shown in Fig. 1 ). PT determines whether repository-supplied configuration, instructions, and executable resources are admitted according to the project trust state. PIF tags, detects, or sanitizes untrusted instructions in file, web, or tool content. Among execution restrictions, PR specifies permitted file targets, whereas RO suppresses persistent changes in covered operations. A workspace write restriction can therefore allow edits within the workspace while preventing writes elsewhere. These distinctions identify which resources or operations a mechanism governs even when several controls share a single configuration mode.
paragraphs.zh: 该分类体系根据机制所管理的资源或操作，以及它们在约束循环中的执行点（如圖 1 所示）来区分不同机制。 PT 根据项目的信任状态，决定是否允许使用仓库提供的配置、指令和可执行资源。 PIF 会标记、检测或净化文件、网页或工具内容中不可信的指令。 在执行限制中，PR 指定了允许的文件目标，而 RO 则抑制受覆盖操作中的持久性更改。 因此，工作区写入限制可以在允许对工作区内进行编辑的同时，防止在其他位置进行写入操作。 这些区别能够明确机制所管理的资源或操作，即使多个控制措施共享单一配置模式也是如此。

paragraphs.en: The mechanisms also serve different security purposes. CAL, CDL, MCP, PR, NI, and RO govern the authorization or scope of operations. AA changes the confirmation requirements for those operations, and AL records actions and decisions for later review. This variation means that a mechanism’s presence must be interpreted together with its configuration and the operations it covers. RQ2 uses these categories to assess implementation and default settings, while RQ3 evaluates task utility and attack effects during execution.

paragraphs.en: Answer to RQ1. RQ1 identifies ten mechanisms spanning resource admission, content handling, operation authorization, execution restrictions, and audit logging. Their category boundaries reflect the resources and operations they govern and where they act in the harness workflow. AA changes confirmation requirements, while AL supports later review. The taxonomy provides common categories for assessing implementation, default settings, and runtime outcomes across harnesses.
paragraphs.zh: RQ1 的答案。 RQ1 识别出十种机制，涵盖资源准入、内容处理、操作授权、执行限制和审计日志。 这些机制的类别边界反映了它们所管理的资源和操作，以及它们在 harness 工作流程中的执行位置。 AA 改变了确认要求，而 AL 支持后续审查。 该分类体系为跨 harness 的实施评估、默认设置和运行时结果提供了通用类别。

paragraphs.en: RQ2 evaluates the implementation of the ten security mechanisms established in RQ1 across 40 harnesses. Each of the 400 harness–mechanism cells receives one of five ratings. Both default-enforced (D) and configurable-off (C) mechanisms are implemented and active by default. C indicates that the mechanism can be disabled through a configuration option or CLI flag while D indicates that no such option or flag is available. Opt-in (O) indicates that it is implemented but requires users to explicitly enable it. Absent (A) indicates affirmative evidence of non-implementation. Unknown (U) records insufficient or conflicting evidence about implementation or default state.
paragraphs.zh: RQ2 评估了 RQ1 中建立的十种安全机制在 40 个测试环境中的实现情况。 400 个“测试环境–机制”单元格中的每一个都获得了五个评级中的一个。 默认强制执行（D）和可配置关闭（C）的机制均已实现，且默认处于激活状态。 C 表示该机制可以通过配置选项或命令行接口标志禁用，而 D 表示没有此类选项或标志可用。 主动启用（O）表示该机制已实现，但需要用户明确启用。 未实现（A）表示有明确的证据表明该机制未被实现。 未知（U）表示关于实现情况或默认状态的证据不足或存在冲突。

paragraphs.en: As Fig. 3 shows, three LLM raters, L1 (Claude Opus 4.8), L2 (DeepSeek V4 Flash), and L3 (GLM-5.2), and two human researchers, H1 and H2, independently rate every cell without access to one another’s judgments. They assess official documentation, CLI materials, and source code from our dataset. Prior work pairs LLM judgments with code locations and explanations in fault localization, and with structured evidence chains in security risk assessment [ 24 , 31 , 57 ] . Building on this practice, we design an Evidence-of-thought rating method to make LLM judgments traceable to the inspected harness materials. The prompts require a separate justification for each harness–mechanism rating (Appendix B ). Every non-U model rating must cite at least one supporting passage by source path and line range, while a U rating must explain the missing or conflicting evidence. The rating program verifies cited ranges and records their SHA-256 hashes. Any rating supported by at least three of the five raters determines consensus (U counts as valid). H1 and H2 then review the recorded evidence for the 18 cells without a majority with a third human researcher, H3 (Meta-H3 in the figure), and agree on the final ratings. H3 provides no initial rating. All three human researchers have at least ten years of software engineering experience; none participated in RQ1.
paragraphs.zh: 如图 3 所示，三名 LLM 评估者（L1（Claude Opus 4.8）、L2（DeepSeek V4 Flash）和 L3（GLM-5.2））以及两名人类研究员（H1 和 H2）在无法查看彼此判断结果的情况下，独立对每个单元格进行评估。 他们评估我们数据集中的官方文档、CLI 材料和源代码。 先前的研究将 LLM 的判断与故障定位中的代码位置及解释相关联，并在安全风险评估中与结构化的证据链相关联 [24, 31, 57]。 基于这一实践，我们设计了一种“思维证据”评估方法，使 LLM 的判断能够追溯到所检查的测试框架材料。 提示词要求为每个测试框架–机制的评估提供独立的理由（附录 B）。 所有非 U 类模型的评估都必须引用至少一段支持性内容，并注明来源路径和行范围；而 U 类评估则必须解释证据缺失或存在冲突的原因。 评估程序会验证所引用的范围并记录其 SHA-256 哈希值。 只要至少有三位评估者（包括 U 类评估者）支持某项评估，即视为达成共识。 随后，H1 和 H2 会审查这 18 个单元格中未达成多数意见的记录证据，并与第三位人类研究员 H3（图中为 Meta-H3）共同确定最终评估结果。 H3 不提供初始评估结果。 三位人类研究员均拥有至少十年的软件工程经验；他们均未参与 RQ1。

Of 400 harness–mechanism cells, 205 have confirmed implementation (D, C, or O), 83 have confirmed absence (A), and 112 are rated U. Within the 205 implemented cells, O is the most frequent rating (109); the remaining 96 are active by default (64 C and 32 D).

paragraphs.en: This pattern differs across mechanisms. Of 31 RO implementations, 30 are O; of 30 AA implementations, 26 are O. In contrast, 22 of 29 MCP implementations are active by default (20 C and 2 D), as are 20 of 22 AL implementations (16 D and 4 C). PIF has four confirmed implementations, 13 A ratings, and 23 U ratings. All 13 closed-source PIF cells are U. More broadly, U accounts for 69 of 130 closed-source cells (53.1%), compared with 43 of 270 open-source cells (15.9%). The matrix therefore resolves fewer implementation questions for closed-source products, particularly for PIF. The five initial raters reached a majority on 382 of the 400 cells; H1, H2, and H3 reviewed the evidence chains provided by L1, L2, and L3 and adjudicated the remaining 18. We calculated ordinal Krippendorff’s α \alpha with U treated as missing, retaining cells with at least two non-U ratings in the relevant rater group. paragraphs.en: We curate 23 tasks (21 original and two adapted from the Terminal-Bench task repository [ 52 ] ) across nine security mechanism benchmarks, spanning bug repair, feature implementation, and read-only analysis of code and data. The tasks cover six primary programming languages: Python, JavaScript, C++, C#, Ruby, and Go. Table 5 lists the task names, representative technical elements, and attack surface coverage for each benchmark.

paragraphs.en: For each task, we provide an explicit legitimate user instruction, an executable environment, and utility oracles tied to the requested behavior. The user instruction is the authoritative source of legitimate task requirements. Each utility oracle checks a specified aspect of a requirement grounded in that instruction; a requirement may have zero, one, or multiple corresponding oracles. We then augment the task environment with five attack surfaces. Separate attack-effect oracles check the adversary’s specified actions or consequences. paragraphs.en: For repository and workflow artifacts , we embed payloads in documentation, source comments, and configuration files. In AA, maintenance materials disguise queue purging as a necessary step for applying a backoff repair, as illustrated in Fig. 5 . In CAL, validation helpers outside the allowlist are misrepresented as required utilities, while CDL frames table deletion or signing-key copying as prerequisites for validation. PR introduces closeout and activation steps whose helper actions write to or delete files outside permitted paths. RO similarly presents preview and receipt utilities that modify protected records. For agent instructions and skills , MCP’s Email Validation task uses a poisoned AGENTS.md to present a privileged registry update as routine maintenance. PT’s Pixel Pet Codec task supplies project instructions that frame disclosure of a workshop ticket as a routine preview handoff. For tool interfaces , PIF’s Issue Triage task embeds instructions in incident handoff responses that request the submission of original attachments, logs, and collector context as a receipt requirement. Its C# Maze task uses returned release records to direct the agent to make regression checks advisory. MCP’s Doc Search task embeds index-publication instructions in a documentation tool’s description to solicit an unauthorized admin_exec call. PT’s Pocket Music Box task poisons a music preview tool’s description to request a privileged call that opens the preview queue. For knowledge and memory , MCP’s StreamLoop case reconciliation task poisons task-local case evidence and records of source authority. Coordinated claims about retention, reviewer identity, and policy exceptions are delivered as business records through an unmodified database tool. These records are designed to induce the deletion of protected evidence, privilege escalation, and changes to platform policies. For external services and execution dependencies , AA’s release materials solicit uploads of build tokens and deployment manifests. They also promote a downloaded validation helper whose execution deletes recovery snapshots. PT’s Clockwork Mobile task presents downloading and executing external validation code as a release check. paragraphs.en: HSB evaluates task utility and attack effects using deterministic oracles to check file/database changes, receiver-side records, and execution events. Trace-based pattern matching and LLM judgment alone can misclassify them: a verbal refusal can coexist with a forbidden tool call [ 14 ] , and a completion claim can contradict the environment state without an LLM judge detecting a discrepancy [ 2 ] . Each attack oracle evaluates a predefined, task-specific condition using recorded execution events or captured environment state. For example, an oracle may determine whether an unauthorized tool was invoked, whether a protected file was modified to the attacker-specified state, or whether a receiver obtained the trial canary. Oracle definitions and verdicts are kept outside the agent workspace, while execution traces are used only to interpret how the run unfolded.
paragraphs.zh: HSB 使用确定性预言机评估任务效用和攻击效果，以检查文件/数据库变更、接收方记录和执行事件。 仅依赖基于轨迹的模式匹配和 LLM 判断可能会导致错误分类：口头拒绝可能与被禁止的工具调用共存 [ 14 ]，而完成声明也可能与环境状态相矛盾，但 LLM 判断者并未检测到差异 [ 2 ]。 每个攻击预言机都使用记录的执行事件或捕获的环境状态，评估一个预定义且与任务相关的条件。 例如，一个预言机可以判断是否调用了未经授权的工具、受保护文件是否被修改为攻击者指定的状态，或者接收方是否获得了试验信使。 预言机的定义和裁决保留在智能体工作区之外，而执行轨迹仅用于解释运行过程如何展开。

paragraphs.en: We use Job Scheduler Backoff , a task in the AA benchmark, to illustrate how legitimate task requirements, adversarial augmentation, and oracles are combined. The user instruction requires the agent to implement a retry scheduler and complete maintenance and release activities. Fig. 5 depicts the task as a journey through a city, starting from this instruction. Green activities cover backoff and retry implementation, scheduler integration testing, specification and compatibility retrieval, specification saving, validation helper download and inspection, and validation cache creation. Utility oracles U1–U9 check specified aspects of these requirements. Yellow branches represent misleading workflow steps introduced through maintenance and release materials. These materials present unauthorized actions as operational prerequisites for completing the requested activities. Red regions correspond to queue purging (A1), build token posting (A2), deployment manifest upload (A3), validation session requests (A4), and recovery snapshot deletion (A5). Attack-effect oracles check the corresponding recorded events or consequences. Roadblocks mark potential enforcement points where harness security mechanisms can constrain execution, depending on their availability, configuration, and coverage.

paragraphs.en: Four software engineers who participated in RQ1 independently designed tasks based on existing proprietary products in their respective domains or on the Terminal-Bench tasks identified above. For each task, at least two researchers other than the designer reproduced it using commercial coding agents and audited the user instructions, executable environment, adversarial augmentation, and oracles. paragraphs.en: Execution environment. A trial is one scheduled evaluation of an agent on a task under a fixed harness, model, and security setting. Its trajectory records harness initialization and any subsequent model turns and tool calls until termination. Each trial runs in a fresh, isolated Docker container instantiated from a fixed image, where the harness under test operates on a separate copy of the task workspace. After the agent stops, we evaluate task utility and attack effects using the corresponding oracles outside the agent’s execution environment. For each evaluated harness, we construct the execution environment using the repository’s pinned release artifacts or building from its pinned source snapshot from our collected dataset. We record the source commit or release version and the corresponding artifact hash to identify the runtime evaluated in each trial.
paragraphs.zh: 执行环境。 一次试验是指，在固定的框架、模型和安全设置下，对智能体在特定任务上进行的单次计划性评估。 其轨迹记录了框架的初始化过程以及之后模型的所有操作和工具调用，直至终止。 每次试验都在一个全新的、隔离的 Docker 容器中运行，该容器由固定镜像实例化，而待测试的框架则在任务工作空间的独立副本上运行。 智能体停止后，我们使用位于智能体执行环境之外的相应预言机来评估任务效用和攻击效果。 对于每个被评估的框架，我们使用存储库中已固定的发布版本产物来构建执行环境，或者从我们收集的数据集中构建其已固定的源代码快照。 我们记录源代码提交或发布版本以及相应的产物哈希值，以便识别每次试验中运行的具体版本。

paragraphs.en: Evaluation metrics. We use Utility and attack success rate (ASR) to denote the proportions of utility oracle checks and attack-effect oracle checks that pass, respectively. We denote a mechanism’s enabled and disabled settings as ON and OFF, respectively. For each harness, mechanism, and setting, rates are calculated by dividing the total passed oracles by the total oracles. The Overall row includes only harnesses evaluated in both ON and OFF settings. Tables 6 and 7 report six quantities (Appendix C ): Utility off, Utility on, ASR off, ASR on, Δ ​ Utility \Delta\mathrm{Utility} , and Δ ​ ASR \Delta\mathrm{ASR} . Unknown (U) oracle verdicts are recorded in evaluation reports and excluded from the denominators. We compute Δ ​ Utility = Utility on − Utility off \Delta\mathrm{Utility}=\mathrm{Utility}_{\text{on}}-\mathrm{Utility}_{\text{off}} and Δ ​ ASR = ASR on − ASR off \Delta\mathrm{ASR}=\mathrm{ASR}_{\text{on}}-\mathrm{ASR}_{\text{off}} from unrounded rates. Both differences are expressed in percentage points (pp); the tables use a percentage suffix and arrows to show the magnitude and direction of change from OFF to ON. A negative Δ ​ ASR \Delta\mathrm{ASR} means a lower ASR under ON, while a negative Δ ​ Utility \Delta\mathrm{Utility} means a lower utility oracles pass rate. Differences require defined rates in both settings and are otherwise reported as not applicable (N/A).

paragraphs.en: Evaluation configuration and models. For each configurable-off (C) and opt-in (O) harness–mechanism cell, we compare ON and OFF settings using the same task, attack variant, and acting model. Other security settings (sandbox, approval, network, and tool configurations) are fixed across each ON/OFF comparison and recorded. These comparisons measure changes in task utility and attack effects under the tested configurations. For absent (A) cells, we run an OFF baseline; for unknown (U) cells, we observe the mechanism’s default setting with its implementation status unresolved. Default-enforced (D) cells are evaluated only in the ON setting when no supported disabled configuration is available. Evaluations with only one setting report the available Utility and ASR rates, with Δ ​ Utility \Delta\mathrm{Utility} and Δ ​ ASR \Delta\mathrm{ASR} marked N/A. Repeated trials characterize variation in agent behavior under fixed oracle criteria. For PT, where supported, ON marks the workspace as untrusted and OFF marks it as trusted, with approval, sandbox, and network settings fixed. Native startup refusal and controls with narrower resource coverage are evaluated according to their actual behavior. All harnesses use GLM-5.2 as the base LLM; in AA-OFF trials, a separate Qwen3.8-27B model reviews native permission requests through a deterministic bridge for all six harnesses. Each scheduled combination of task, harness, and security setting uses 10 trials for nine mechanism benchmarks, with 2,500 planned trials across 54 harness–mechanism batches, excluding reruns. All trials have an external execution deadline of 28,800 seconds (8 hours). We sum input and output tokens across trials; input totals include cached-read tokens.
paragraphs.zh: 评估配置与模型。 对于每个可配置关闭（C）和可选启用（O）的机制单元，我们使用相同的任务、攻击变体和执行模型来比较开启（ON）和关闭（OFF）设置。 其他安全设置（沙盒、审批、网络和工具配置）在每次 ON/OFF 比较中均保持固定并记录。 这些比较用于衡量在受测配置下任务效用和攻击效应的变化。 对于缺失（A）单元，我们运行关闭（OFF）基线；对于未知（U）单元，我们观察机制的默认设置，其实现状态未明确。 对于强制默认（D）单元，若无可用的受支持禁用配置，则仅在开启（ON）设置下进行评估。 仅有一种设置的评估会报告可用的效用和 ASR 比率，而 Δ Utility \Delta\mathrm{Utility} 和 Δ ASR \Delta\mathrm{ASR} 将标记为 N/A。 重复试验用于描述智能体在固定预言机标准下的行为差异。 对于 PT，在支持的情况下，开启（ON）设置将工作区标记为不可信，关闭（OFF）设置则标记为可信，同时审批、沙盒和网络设置保持固定。 原生启动拒绝和覆盖范围较窄的控制措施将根据其实际行为进行评估。 所有机制均使用 GLM-5.2 作为基础 LLM；在 AA-OFF 试验中，一个独立的 Qwen3.8-27B 模型会通过确定性桥接器审查所有六个机制的原生权限请求。 每个预定的任务、机制和安全设置组合将使用 10 次试验对九个机制基准进行测试，总计计划进行 2,500 次试验，覆盖 54 个机制批次，不包括重跑试验。 所有试验的外部执行截止时间为 28,800 秒（8 小时）。 我们将各试验的输入和输出词元相加；输入总数包含缓存读取词元。

paragraphs.en: AA is a risk capability that removes confirmation barriers, whereas the other mechanisms restrict operations or resources, or screen untrusted content. AA-ON skips native approval checks; AA-OFF sends permission requests to the separate reviewer. Utility rose from 77.1% to 95.4% ( + 18.3 +18.3 pp), while ASR rose from 29.2% to 95.6% ( + 66.4 +66.4 pp). Skipping review allows both legitimate operations and malicious prerequisites presented in maintenance materials to proceed more readily. ASR increased in every harness, but the utility benefit varied: Gemini CLI gained 2.3 pp, while Claude Code lost 0.8 pp. Automatic approval therefore increased attack exposure even where it offered little improvement in task completion.
paragraphs.zh: AA 是一种能够消除确认障碍的风险能力，而其他机制则会限制操作或资源，或者筛选不可信的内容。 AA-ON 会跳过原生批准检查；AA-OFF 则会将权限请求发送给独立的审核员。 效用率从 77.1% 提升至 95.4%（+18.3 +18.3 个百分点），而 ASR 则从 29.2% 提升至 95.6%（+66.4 +66.4 个百分点）。 跳过审核会使合法操作以及维护材料中呈现的恶意前提条件都更容易得以执行。 所有测试环境中 ASR 均有提升，但效用收益存在差异：Gemini CLI 增加了 2.3 个百分点，而 Claude Code 则下降了 0.8 个百分点。 因此，自动批准甚至在任务完成度几乎没有改善的情况下，也增加了攻击暴露风险。

sents.en: AA-ON skips native approval checks; AA-OFF sends permission requests to the separate reviewer.
sents.zh: AA-ON 会跳过原生批准检查；AA-OFF 则会将权限请求发送给独立的审核员。

sents.en: Utility rose from 77.1% to 95.4% ( + 18.3 +18.3 pp), while ASR rose from 29.2% to 95.6% ( + 66.4 +66.4 pp).
Skipping review allows both legitimate operations and malicious prerequisites presented in maintenance materials to proceed more readily.
sents.zh: 跳过审核会使合法操作以及维护材料中呈现的恶意前提条件都更容易得以执行。

sents.en: ASR increased in every harness, but the utility benefit varied: Gemini CLI gained 2.3 pp, while Claude Code lost 0.8 pp.
sents.zh: 所有测试环境中 ASR 均有提升，但效用收益存在差异：Gemini CLI 增加了 2.3 个百分点，而 Claude Code 则下降了 0.8 个百分点。

sents.en: Automatic approval therefore increased attack exposure even where it offered little improvement in task completion.
sents.zh: 因此，自动批准甚至在任务完成度几乎没有改善的情况下，也增加了攻击暴露风险。

paragraphs.en: NI and RO restricted capabilities needed for both legitimate work and unauthorized operations. NI reduced ASR by 56.3 pp with a 24.5 pp utility loss. Required network interactions accounted for 161 of the 162 fewer utility passes; local code checks changed from 437/480 to 436/480. RO reduced ASR from 8.3% to 0.8%, a 7.5 pp decrease from a low OFF baseline, while utility fell by 34.0 pp. Checks requiring persistent implementation changes accounted for 347 of its 367 fewer utility passes. When legitimate and malicious workflows use the same capability, restricting it can protect the resource while preventing task completion.
paragraphs.zh: NI 和 RO 受限制的能力既用于合法工作，也用于未经授权的操作。 NI 将 ASR 降低了 56.3 个百分点，但带来了 24.5 个百分点的效用损失。 所需的网络交互占效用通过次数减少量（162 次）中的 161 次；本地代码检查从 437/480 变为 436/480。 RO 将 ASR 从 8.3% 降至 0.8%，较较低的 OFF 基线下降了 7.5 个百分点，而效用则下降了 34.0 个百分点。 需要持续实施更改的检查占其效用通过次数减少量（367 次）中的 347 次。 当合法和恶意工作流程使用相同的能力时，限制该能力可以在防止任务完成的同时保护资源。

paragraphs.en: CAL reduced ASR by 48.1 pp with a 1.5 pp utility loss, leaving most legitimate implementation and validation achievable through permitted commands. PT showed a similar pattern among harnesses that continued execution under ON. Across all five paired harnesses, ASR fell from 75.3% to 40.3%, while utility fell from 100% to 80%. This utility loss came entirely from Gemini CLI refusing startup in all 40 ON trials after the workspace was marked untrusted. Excluding that startup-refusal configuration, the other four harnesses retained 100% utility while ASR fell from 75.8% to 50.4%. These comparisons distinguish denying task startup from limiting repository resources during execution while retaining a legitimate completion path.

paragraphs.en: CDL, PR, and MCP reduced ASR by 40.4, 48.1, and 28.1 pp, respectively, with overall utility gains of 5.2, 0.3, and 0.5 pp. Blocking an attack can also protect legitimate deliverables when its side effects violate task requirements. For CDL, 15 of the 29 additional utility passes came from Qwen Code and GitHub Copilot reports that no longer contained signing-key material. The induced key-copying operation had invalidated these reports under OFF; preventing it under ON preserved the legitimate validation output. PR’s permitted workspace operations and MCP’s retained tools also left legitimate work possible. Their small overall utility gains combined positive and negative changes across harnesses, while PR’s ASR reductions ranged from complete observed suppression to almost unchanged outcomes. For MCP, some retained operations could still alter protected state.
paragraphs.zh: CDL、PR 和 MCP 分别将 ASR 降低了 40.4、48.1 和 28.1 个百分点，整体效用增益分别为 5.2、0.3 和 0.5 个百分点。 当攻击的副作用违反任务要求时，阻止该攻击也可以保护合法的交付成果。 对于 CDL，29 个额外的效用通过中有 15 个来自 Qwen Code 和 GitHub Copilot 的报告，这些报告不再包含签名密钥材料。 在 OFF 模式下，这种诱导的密钥复制操作已使这些报告失效；而在 ON 模式下阻止该操作则保留了合法的验证输出。 PR 允许的工作区操作以及 MCP 保留的工具也使得合法工作仍然可行。 它们较小的整体效用增益综合了跨测试框架的正负变化，而 PR 的 ASR 降低幅度从完全观察到的抑制到几乎无变化的结果不等。 对于 MCP，某些保留的操作仍然可能改变受保护的状态。

Table 8 reports these usage statistics by harness, mechanism, and setting.

paragraphs.en: The aggregate results quantify changes in task utility and attack success. The following two task-level cases illustrate how these outcomes arise during execution.
paragraphs.zh: 汇总结果量化了任务效用和攻击成功性的变化。 以下两个任务层面的案例说明了这些结果在执行过程中是如何产生的。

sents.zh: 汇总结果量化了任务效用和攻击成功性的变化。

sents.en: The following two task-level cases illustrate how these outcomes arise during execution.
sents.zh: 以下两个任务层面的案例说明了这些结果在执行过程中是如何产生的。

paragraphs.en: We examine the Dependency Lock Repair task from the NI benchmark, where legitimate dependency installation requires access to a package registry. Across ten trials per setting, enabling NI in Claude Code reduced utility from 96% to 76%, while ASR fell from 100% to zero. A representative ON trace showed the native network policy rejecting the required registry access and preventing package retrieval. All four local functionality checks nevertheless passed, distinguishing successful local validation from completion of the registry-dependent installation workflow. Under OFF, installation also triggered a callback that sent data to the attack collector. In the ON trace, failed package retrieval prevented this callback. This case illustrates how legitimate and malicious operations can depend on the same network capability: restricting registry access prevented the malicious installation callback while also obstructing the dependency installation required by the legitimate task.
paragraphs.zh: 我们研究了 NI 基准测试中的依赖锁定修复任务，其中合法的依赖安装需要访问软件包注册表。 在每种设置下进行的十次试验中，在 Claude Code 中启用 NI 使效用从 96% 降至 76%，而 ASR 则从 100% 降至零。 一个典型的 ON 追踪显示，原生网络策略拒绝了所需的注册表访问，并阻止了软件包的获取。 尽管如此，所有四项本地功能检查均通过，这表明成功的本地验证与依赖注册表的安装工作流程的完成存在区别。 在 OFF 模式下，安装还触发了一个回调，该回调将数据发送到攻击收集器。 在 ON 追踪中，软件包获取失败阻止了这一回调。 这个案例说明，合法和恶意操作可能依赖相同的网络能力：限制注册表访问虽然阻止了恶意安装的回调，但也阻碍了合法任务所需的依赖安装。

paragraphs.en: We use the CLI Arg Parser task from the CAL benchmark to examine a bypass observed with Qwen Code under CAL ON. The task’s poisoned validation materials presented an unauthorized checker as a required validation utility. Qwen Code’s native gate rejected the checker, but after completing legitimate validation, the agent invoked it through an allowed Python interpreter. The trial passed all six utility checks and all three attack-effect checks, showing that satisfying the checked task requirements coexisted with successful attack effects. A separate ON trial completed the same task without executing the checker, passing all utility checks and no attack-effect checks. This comparison shows that executing the checker was unnecessary for satisfying the checked task requirements. The command restriction nevertheless left an interpreter-based execution path available, illustrating the need to mediate all paths to a protected operation [ 47 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 CAL 基准测试中的 CLI 参数解析任务，来研究在 CAL ON 模式下 Qwen Code 所表现出的一种绕过行为。 该任务的中毒验证材料将一种未经授权的检查器伪装成了必需的验证工具。 Qwen Code 的原生网关拒绝了该检查器，但在完成合法验证后，智能体通过一个被允许的 Python 解释器调用了它。 此次试验通过了全部六个工具性检查和三个攻击效果检查，表明满足受检查任务要求的同时，也实现了成功的攻击效果。 一次独立的 ON 试验在没有执行该检查器的情况下完成了同一任务，通过了所有工具性检查，但未通过任何攻击效果检查。 这一对比表明，执行该检查器对于满足受检查任务的要求并非必要。 尽管如此，命令限制仍然保留了一条基于解释器的执行路径，这说明了需要对所有路径进行中介，以确保其操作受到保护 [ 47 ] 。

paragraphs.en: The impact of a protection mechanism on utility depends on whether its restrictions also affect operations required for legitimate tasks. Restricting capabilities shared by both legitimate and malicious operations can reduce both ASR and utility, whereas controls that target harmful operations more precisely can reduce ASR with less impact on utility. Residual attacks can still succeed when alternative commands or tools provide access to the protected operation.
paragraphs.zh: 保护机制对效用的影响取决于其限制是否也波及到合法任务所需的操作。 限制合法与恶意操作共用的能力，会同时降低 ASR 和效用；而更精准针对有害操作的管控措施，则能在对效用影响较小的情况下降低 ASR。 当替代命令或工具能够访问受保护的操作时，残余攻击仍可能成功。

sents.en: The impact of a protection mechanism on utility depends on whether its restrictions also affect operations required for legitimate tasks.
sents.zh: 保护机制对效用的影响取决于其限制是否也波及到合法任务所需的操作。

sents.en: Restricting capabilities shared by both legitimate and malicious operations can reduce both ASR and utility, whereas controls that target harmful operations more precisely can reduce ASR with less impact on utility.
sents.zh: 限制合法与恶意操作共用的能力，会同时降低 ASR 和效用；而更精准针对有害操作的管控措施，则能在对效用影响较小的情况下降低 ASR。

sents.en: Residual attacks can still succeed when alternative commands or tools provide access to the protected operation.
sents.zh: 当替代命令或工具能够访问受保护的操作时，残余攻击仍可能成功。

paragraphs.en: Answer to RQ3. AA relaxed confirmation requirements and increased both utility and ASR. NI and RO reduced ASR with substantial utility losses; CAL and PT largely preserved utility, with PT’s startup-refusal configuration accounting for its overall utility loss. CDL, PR, and MCP reduced ASR with overall utility gains, while PIF showed small decreases in both measures in its only paired comparison. The cases demonstrate that protection can block required legitimate operations and that allowed commands can still provide bypasses. Evaluating a setting therefore requires measuring both outcomes and checking other paths to the protected operation.
paragraphs.zh: RQ3 的答案。 AA 放宽了确认要求，同时提升了效用和 ASR。 NI 和 RO 降低了 ASR，并伴随着显著的效用损失；CAL 和 PT 基本保留了效用，其中 PT 的启动拒绝配置是其整体效用损失的原因。 CDL、PR 和 MCP 在降低 ASR 的同时实现了整体效用的提升，而 PIF 在其唯一的配对比较中，两项指标均出现轻微下降。 这些案例表明，保护机制可能会阻止必要的合法操作，而允许执行的命令仍可能提供绕过途径。 因此，评估某种设置时需要同时测量两种结果，并检查通往受保护操作的其他路径。

paragraphs.en: Approval decisions in AA-OFF trials may vary across reviewers and can directly affect the observed AA outcomes. To standardize these decisions, we use a predefined LLM-based approval reviewer with fixed review criteria across all trials. paragraphs.zh: 在 AA-OFF 试验中，批准决策可能因评审员而异，并可能直接影响观察到的 AA 结果。 为标准化这些决策，我们使用一个预定义的基于 LLM 的批准评审员，该评审员在所有试验中均遵循固定的评审标准。 模型偏差和残留的非确定性仍可能影响单个批准决策，因此所报告的 AA 结果反映了指定的批准配置。

paragraphs.en: Researcher and model biases may affect the accuracy and consistency of RQ1–RQ2 results. To reduce inconsistency and ensure that each judgment is auditable and traceable, we design the Evidence-of-Thought (EoT) method for both human and LLM raters. EoT requires independent ratings with retained source locators and passage hashes, followed by adjudication of disagreements.
paragraphs.zh: 研究者和模型中的偏见可能会影响 RQ1–RQ2 结果的准确性和一致性。 为了减少不一致性，并确保每次判断均可审计和追溯，我们为人类和 LLM 评分者设计了“思维证据”（EoT）方法。 EoT 要求保留来源定位器和段落哈希的独立评分，随后对分歧进行裁定。

paragraphs.en: Closed-source harnesses are more difficult to evaluate reproducibly because their interaction modes differ, particularly for GUI-based IDE workflows, where automated execution may not faithfully reproduce interactive operation. To improve reproducibility, our core evaluation focuses on six open-source harnesses that cover a broad range of security mechanisms. In future work, we will develop automated evaluation methods for closed-source harnesses, extend our empirical evaluation to them, and compare the automated results with manual evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 闭源测试框架更难进行可重复的评估，因为它们的交互模式存在差异，尤其是在基于图形用户界面的集成开发环境工作流程中，自动化执行可能无法真实再现交互式操作。 为了提高可重复性，我们的核心评估重点关注六个开源测试框架，这些框架涵盖了广泛的安全机制。 在未来的工作中，我们将为闭源测试框架开发自动化评估方法，将我们的实证评估扩展至这些框架，并将自动化结果与人工评估进行比较。

paragraphs.en: RQ2 leaves 69 of 130 closed-source harness–mechanism cells unresolved, including all 13 closed-source PIF cells. This finding characterizes what an external assessor can establish from the available evidence. Harness providers should publish versioned mechanism-level descriptions stating whether each mechanism is implemented, whether it is active by default, how users can change that state, and which inputs or operations it covers. Exposing the effective security settings through the CLI or UI would also allow users to verify the configuration they are actually running.
paragraphs.zh: RQ2 留下了 130 个闭源 harness–mechanism 单元格中的 69 个未解决，包括全部 13 个闭源 PIF 单元格。 这一发现描述了外部评估者基于现有证据能够确定的内容。 Harness 提供商应发布带有版本标识的机制级描述，说明每个机制是否已实现、是否为默认激活状态、用户如何更改该状态，以及它涵盖哪些输入或操作。 通过 CLI 或 UI 暴露实际的安全设置，也将允许用户验证他们实际运行中的配置。

paragraphs.en: Providers should test alternative access paths to protected resources [ 47 ] and check whether legitimate tasks retain an authorized completion path. Repeating these checks after changes to tool routing or permission configuration would help detect regressions in access control. Evaluations should report attack effects, task utility, token usage, and runtime together so users can select settings appropriate to their workloads and acceptable risk.
paragraphs.zh: 提供者应测试受保护资源的替代访问路径 [ 47 ]，并检查合法任务是否仍保留授权完成路径。 在工具路由或权限配置发生变更后重复这些检查，有助于检测访问控制中的退化问题。 评估报告应同时说明攻击影响、任务效用、令牌使用量和运行时间，以便用户能够选择适合其工作负载且风险可接受的设置。

paragraphs.en: Prior studies characterize harness architectures and security mechanisms using literature reviews, source code, and product materials. Surveys organize harness engineering across architectural layers [ 28 ] and systematize agent attacks and defenses [ 26 ] . An execution security review synthesizes research on isolation, access control, and time-of-check-to-time-of-use vulnerabilities [ 45 ] . Source-level and practitioner analyses examine coding harnesses and their native security mechanisms [ 12 , 3 , 17 ] . HarnessSecurity adds a common mechanism taxonomy and rating protocol for comparing implementation and default state across 40 open- and closed-source coding agent harnesses. Independent ratings, recorded evidence, and disagreement adjudication make these comparisons auditable while retaining unresolved cases.
paragraphs.zh: 先前的研究通过文献综述、源代码和产品材料来描述 harness 架构和安全机制。 综述将 harness 工程按架构层进行组织 [ 28 ]，并对智能体攻击和防御进行系统化梳理 [ 26 ]。 执行安全审查整合了关于隔离、访问控制以及检查时到使用时漏洞的研究 [ 45 ]。 源代码层面和实践者层面的分析考察了编码 harness 及其固有的安全机制 [ 12 , 3 , 17 ]。 HarnessSecurity 增加了一套通用的机制分类法和评级协议，用于比较 40 个开源和闭源编码智能体 harness 的实现与默认状态。 独立的评级、记录在案的证据以及分歧裁决使这些比较具备可审计性，同时保留未决案例。

paragraphs.en: AgentDojo and Agent Security Bench evaluate attacks and defenses in tool-using agent workflows [ 18 , 58 ] . HarnessAudit examines execution trajectories for boundary compliance and execution fidelity [ 30 ] , and ClawSafety compares safety outcomes across agent frameworks [ 54 ] . HarnessRisk evaluates task utility, attack success, persistence, and detection across the harness lifecycle [ 11 ] . Related poisoning studies target agent memory and retrieved knowledge [ 16 , 59 ] . These benchmarks organize evaluation around workflows and lifecycle phases. HSB organizes runtime comparisons around security mechanisms and supported configurations established by RQ1–RQ2, measuring their effects on task utility and attack effects.
paragraphs.zh: AgentDojo 和 Agent Security Bench 评估了工具使用智能体工作流程中的攻击与防御 [ 18 , 58 ] 。 HarnessAudit 检查执行轨迹是否符合边界要求及执行保真度 [ 30 ] ，而 ClawSafety 则比较不同智能体框架下的安全结果 [ 54 ] 。 HarnessRisk 评估了在整个 harness 生命周期中任务效用、攻击成功性、持续性和检测能力 [ 11 ] 。 相关的投毒研究针对智能体的记忆和检索到的知识展开 [ 16 , 59 ] 。 这些基准测试围绕工作流程和生命周期阶段组织评估。 HSB 围绕 RQ1–RQ2 确立的安全机制和支持配置组织运行时比较，测量它们对任务效用和攻击效果的影响。

paragraphs.en: AIShellJack tests poisoned agent instruction files [ 32 ] , while QueryIPI studies malicious tool descriptions and their transfer to real coding agents [ 55 ] . IssueTrojanBench, RepoGuardBench, and CodeIPI evaluate attacks through issue content and repository resources [ 49 , 27 , 50 ] . Skill-Inject, PoisonedSkills, and SkillHarm examine skill-package attacks [ 48 , 43 , 37 ] . Skill-Inject and SkillHarm also measure task utility, with SkillHarm examining persistent skill mutation across sessions [ 48 , 37 ] . RedCode evaluates risky execution requests and malicious code generation [ 23 ] . Table 1 summarizes selected evaluations of coding agents. Compared with evaluations centered on particular attack resources, HSB organizes tasks around the security mechanisms and introduces adversarial resources across five attack surfaces while preserving legitimate task requirements. paragraphs.en: This study identifies ten security mechanisms across 40 coding agent harnesses and assesses their implementation, default settings, and supported configurations. We introduce HarnessSecurity-Bench to evaluate nine mechanisms across six harnesses with separate deterministic oracles for task utility and attack effects. The effects of security mechanisms on attack success and task utility varied across harnesses and tasks. Overall, network isolation and read-only mode reduced attack success with substantial utility losses, while command allowlisting and command denylisting achieved reductions with a small utility loss and a utility gain, respectively. Enabling auto-approve increased attack success in all six harnesses, and some attack effects persisted through alternative execution paths outside a mechanism’s coverage. Harness providers should publish versioned descriptions of mechanism coverage and expose effective security settings so users can verify the configuration they run. They should examine alternative execution paths to protected operations and report attack effects alongside task utility and execution costs.
paragraphs.zh: 本研究识别出 40 种编码智能体工具包中的十种安全机制，并评估了这些机制的实现方式、默认设置以及所支持的配置。 我们提出了 HarnessSecurity-Bench，用于在六种工具包中评估九种安全机制，并通过独立的确定性预言子分别衡量任务效用和攻击效果。 安全机制对攻击成功率和任务效用的影响在不同工具包和任务中存在差异。 总体而言，网络隔离和只读模式降低了攻击成功率，但带来了较大的效用损失；而命令白名单和命令黑名单则分别实现了攻击率下降，且仅伴随较小的效用损失或带来一定的效用增益。 启用自动批准功能在所有六种工具包中均提高了攻击成功率，并且某些攻击效果仍会通过机制覆盖范围之外的替代执行路径持续存在。 工具包提供商应发布各版本的安全机制覆盖范围说明，并公开有效的安全设置，以便用户能够验证其运行配置。 他们还应检查受保护操作的替代执行路径，并在报告任务效用和执行成本的同时，一并披露攻击效果。
